newsitem.title: UK: Ted Bakers rises to premium on LSE debut.
newsitem.headline: Ted Bakers rises to premium on LSE debut.

text.p: Shares in clothing designer and retailer Ted Baker Plc nudged up to a 3.3 percent premium on their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange, dealers said.
Ted Baker shares, issued at 135p, rose 4-1/2p to 139-1/2p by 1457 GMT in volume of 1.4 million shares.
Ted Baker designs, wholesales and retails fashionable shirts, knitwear, jeans and jackets which are sold in Britain through its seven stores, a concession at Harrods and selected retailers.
The company made operating profits of 4.2 million stg in the year to January 25 1997 and said retail sales in the first 20 weeks of its current financial year rose by more than 25 percent in Britain.
